RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about your denied claim. I've reviewed your case and confirmed that the denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". I understand that your doctor ordered the MRI for your migraines, and I'm here to help you with the next steps.

You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. Since the denial notice was sent on September 5, your appeal deadline is March 4, 2027. To initiate the appeal process, please complete the attached appeal form (FORM-APP-1) and submit it to us along with any supporting documentation from your doctor, including clinical records that support the medical necessity of the MRI.

If you have any questions or need assistance with the appeal process, please don't hesitate to contact me. I'm here to help. You can also find more information about our appeals process on our website.

Please note that we will decide on your appeal within 30 calendar days of receiving your completed form and supporting documentation.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to me.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
